description: ASP.NET Core is a .NET tool for websites and APIs. Minimal APIs let a small function handle a web request. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n School, enter School, and replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. Stop the app before changing examples.
versionNote: Examples use .NET 8 or later with minimal APIs.
whatYouWillLearn: Make a minimal route with ASP.NET Core
Constrain a route number with ASP.NET Core
Check a body value with ASP.NET Core
Receive a shared helper with ASP.NET Core
learningObjectives: Make a minimal route with ASP.NET Core
Read an optional query with ASP.NET Core
Group related paths with ASP.NET Core
